scope.boundary: D-07 is the single post-implementation boundary for T232: C11 full per-project suites (core/sqlite/postgres/sqlserver/mysql/mariadb/clickhouse) plus the six-provider container integration run, C12 candidate coverage over the same boundary, C15 acceptance perf, C16 footprint, C17/C18/C19 sealing. No filtered inner subset is run; the boundary is the one comprehensive sweep.
scope.rationale: D-07 adds no production scope: it runs the one authorized boundary sweep, measures the candidate coverage/perf and seals the evidence. The recorded executions are the C11 boundary (its per-project suites and the six-provider container run are captured in rv1/boundary.json and logs/boundary-*.out), the C12 coverage candidate and the C15 acceptance perf; the sealed evidence is validated by C17/C18/C19. No compiled file is authored by D-07.
